name: Santiuste de San Juan Bautista (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santiuste de San Juan Bautista (a red cross on white, a pine and a bend).
history: Municipal flag of Santiuste de San Juan Bautista; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santiuste de San Juan Bautista arms — red cross on white, pine and bend
